record.question: Which of the following is associated with a time between breakfast and noon?
record.explanation: Fehrehsan denotes the period after breakfast and before the midday meal. SCERT’s vocabulary notes explicitly define it as “Tukthuan eikham leh chawfak hun inkar”. Reference: https://scert.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/a380379144655fe1f3d99cd8a096a462/pages-125-june-1st-issue.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
